function.name: ask_user_question
function.description: Ask the user a structured question and wait for their answer. Use this when you genuinely need clarification before proceeding — e.g. "which framework should I use", "is this destructive operation OK", "which file did you mean". Avoid for trivial questions you could resolve from context. The user's answer is returned as the tool result string.

question.description: The question to present to the user. Be specific and concise.

choices.description: Optional list of multiple-choice options. If provided, the chat UI renders them as clickable buttons. Leave empty for a free-text answer.
